summary: Bound replication export snapshot waits and expose reader age and WAL checkpoint deferral

schema.detail: No durable schema or wire-format changes.

rules.detail: Replication inventories and digests still use one consistent snapshot.

compatibility.detail: Export snapshot mutex waits now honor the existing read deadline and cancellation. Export no longer retains a handler-wide reader while waiting for sealing or verdict writes. Expired exports return the existing read-deadline error for peer retry, without a partial exchange. Storage telemetry adds oldest reader scope age by bounded origin, checkpoint deferral attempts, unbackfilled frame lag and deferral age.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary restart is required.

recovery.detail: Peers retry an expired export through the existing replication recovery path.
